runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle; evidence tree = `git archive HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md` only)
old_value_note: <absent> — the leaf did not exist in the previous baseline

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

independent_computation.step_0_scenario_identification: The '_120' suffix is Syndra's Splinters of Wrath stack option at its maximum, not a rank or a duration. data/worklists/e3-stacks.json (/166/hint) and data/champions.json Syndra P: 'Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath ... stacking up to 120 times' and 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' The scenario therefore runs Syndra with all four Transcendent thresholds live (40 Q charges / 60 W true damage / 80 E slow / 100 R execute) plus the 120-stack +15% AP.
independent_computation.step_1_what_the_leaf_can_mean: The leaf sits at rotation -> aoe -> R, i.e. the per-ability entry for R inside the AoE-scoped rotation report. Every numeric reading of that slot (casts of R scheduled in the AoE rotation; enemies R damages in the AoE profile) is computed below, and both independently evaluate to 1. The only reading under which <absent> could be right is 'aoe is a whitelist of multi-target-only abilities'; that reading is addressed and rejected in step 4.

step_2_R_cast_count_in_a_rotation.sourced_inputs: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0].cooldown.modifiers = values [120, 100, 80] (affectedByCdr: true); castTime 0.25 s.
step_2_R_cast_count_in_a_rotation.rule_quoted: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 5 formula-audit table, row 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)': edge case column reads 'R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)'. The 'Ability rotation casts (_schedule_shared_casts, _compute_ability_rotation)' row repeats it: '... R single-cast'. The audit conclusion lists 'R single-cast' among the documented modeling conventions.
step_2_R_cast_count_in_a_rotation.arithmetic: Even at rank 3 the effective cooldown is cd' = cd * 100/(100 + AH) = 80 * 100/(100+AH); for any plausible AH (<= 100) that is >= 40 s, far beyond a rotation/fight window, so the shared-timeline renewal schedule 0, c_R, 2c_R, ... contributes exactly one cast start inside the window. At rank 1 (cd 120 s) this is even less contestable.
step_2_R_cast_count_in_a_rotation.result: R cast count in the rotation = 1

step_3_R_target_count_in_an_AoE_fight.sourced_inputs: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0]: targeting = 'Unit', affects = 'Enemies', spellEffects = 'spell' (contrast: Syndra Q/W/E all carry spellEffects = 'Aoe'; Ahri R carries 'aoe').
step_3_R_target_count_in_an_AoE_fight.wiki_text_quoted: Effect 2: 'Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.' Effect 3: 'The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.' — the spheres deal no landing/splash damage; all damage lands on the single unit-targeted champion.
step_3_R_target_count_in_an_AoE_fight.field_disambiguation: effectRadius 3000 is the sphere-collection radius (how far away live spheres are gathered from), not a damage radius; targetRange 675 is the cast range. The multiplicity in R (3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed = 3..7 spheres) is a hit count against ONE target, not a target count — which is also why 1 cannot be a sphere count.
step_3_R_target_count_in_an_AoE_fight.atom_definition_quoted: data/wiki-atoms/damage.json -> atom 'damage.aoe': 'Damage capable of hitting multiple units, recognized by the AOE tag'. Syndra R carries no such tag in the cache (spellEffects = 'spell').

independent_computation.step_4_rejecting_the_absent_reading: If rotation/aoe were a whitelist containing only multi-target abilities, R would be excluded and <absent> would be right. Three things argue against it: (a) the recorded value is the integer 1, not a boolean — a membership flag would serialize as true/false; (b) an AoE-scoped rotation that silently drops R would omit a real damage source that is still cast once and still damages one enemy in an AoE fight, understating the scenario total; (c) 1 is exactly the value both numeric readings independently produce, so the recorded number is consistent with the ability's sourced behavior either way. <absent> (equivalently 0 casts / 0 targets) contradicts the sourced facts that R is cast once per fight and damages at least one enemy.
independent_computation.conclusion: Both independent derivations give 1: R is scheduled exactly once (cooldown 120/100/80 s, and docs/math-foundations.md pins 'R single-cast' / 'R casts exactly once per timed fight'), and R damages exactly one enemy (targeting 'Unit', spellEffects 'spell', barrage aimed at 'the target enemy champion', spheres deal no landing damage). The Transcendent 100-Splinter execute and the 120-stack +15% AP change R's damage, not its cast count or its target count, so the 120-splinter coupling does not alter the answer. The new value 1 is correct; the previous <absent> was wrong.
